### AMTD IDEA's core businesses updates; and key highlights and achievements


October 20, 2026


PARIS and NEW YORK and SINGAPORE


, Oct. 20, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --AMTD IDEA Group ("AMTD IDEA") (NYSE: AMTD; SGX: HKB) announces that AMTD IDEA has successfully built its various core business lines to establish global positioning and presence, as well as achieve market significance


by way of fundamental strengths and through strong global intellectual properties'


("IP")' power of influence


and huge opportunities of IP extended businesses. In addition, AMTD IDEA has established a solid base of total assets and net assets through its ownership, alongside its


subsidiaries, the global portfolio of hotels including both the underlying lands and buildings with over US$1 billion value


.


To sum up, as an overall update:


- Global media and IPs: L'Officiel and The Art Newspaper, covering over 30 countries and major cities


- IP extended business to expand: L'Officiel Coffee & Bar's success in Tokyo and Macao paved the way for next location opening


- Global hotels network under AMTD brand approaching 1,000 rooms in over 4 continents


- Digital and tech investments to grow continuously: EleBank (one of the eight digital banks in Hong Kong


), WeDoctor (China online healthcare and digital health infrastructure platform)


- Global entertainment to continue investing: supreme success in *The Last Dance, Scare Out, Moscow Mission,* etc., with pipelines including Raging Havoc.


AMTD IDEA is the consolidating company and the parent group of AMTD Digital Inc. (NYSE: HKD) and The Generation Essentials Group (NYSE: TGE; LSE: TGE).


**About AMTD IDEA Group**


AMTD IDEA Group (NYSE: AMTD; SGX: HKB) represents a diversified institution and digital solutions conglomerate group, connecting companies and investors with global markets. Its comprehensive one-stop business services plus digital solutions platform addresses different clients' diverse and inter-connected business needs and digital requirements across all phases of their life cycles. AMTD IDEA Group is uniquely positioned as an active super connector between clients, business partners, investee companies, and investors, connecting the East and the West. For more information, please visit[www.amtdinc.com](https://www.amtdinc.com/) or follow us on X (formerly known as "Twitter") at @AMTDGroup.
